name: 86 Chaos 18.0.0
label: 86 Chaos 18.0.0
releaseTitle: Native Mobile and Firebase Cost Foundation
notes: Mobile branch only; testing, experimental, and production are unchanged.
Capacitor 8.5.2 Android and iOS projects are generated from the exact deployed 17.0.42 baseline.
Android and iPhone/iPad are equal targets with dedicated targeted and Release Gate coverage.
No new paid service or separate Firebase project is introduced.
title: 86 Chaos 18.0.0
summary: Begins the isolated Android and iPhone/iPad mobile line from the exact deployed 17.0.42 testing baseline.
description: Adds the cross-platform mobile contract, mobile-specific Firebase listener cost controls, download/distribution groundwork, and explicit Android/iOS parity requirements without changing the production or testing branches.
highlights: Native Android and iOS shells share application identity com.chiltonappworks.chaos86 and release version 18.0.0.
Backgrounded native sessions use a 15-second idle Firestore listener release window while retaining local cached data.
Camera, microphone, and notification permission foundations are present for existing 86 Chaos workflows.
The mobile Vercel preview is locked to the existing testing Firebase project and is isolated from testing/production branches.
Android Chromium and iPhone WebKit targeted Release Gate coverage is included.
